title: Claude + Canva Fix: Make It Read the Template Structure First
description:
The Canva connector dumps text into random boxes because Claude is guessing. Have it read the template first (text boxes, character limits, hierarchy), then fill it.

Inside the Wright Mode membership I share fixes like this weekly: https://www.skool.com/wright-mode/about
